authority.alpha_prerequisite: Every code-bearing or structural package is planned against the real baseline before implementation.

current_behavior: The repository has a detailed manual change-authoring routine and deterministic file inventory, but no program binds an implementation diff to an earlier committed plan. A code change can therefore omit a file, claim an incomplete read, change its plan in the same commit, or bypass its recorded evidence while the existing policy checks still pass.
target_behavior: A standard-library-only validator discovers the commit that introduced this active package, proves that its parent is the declared baseline and that it was planning-only, authenticates complete baseline file reviews, and rejects every undeclared committed, staged, unstaged, or untracked path plus every incomplete planning field. Candidate CI runs the validator with full Git history and workflow policy proves that binding remains present.
unchanged_behavior: No RRFlow engine, storage, graph, lexical, vector, DataFusion, context, reasoning, transport, installation, or runtime behavior changes.
README.md remains the product portal; the objective, canonical roadmap, POA&M, and execution map retain their existing authority order.
The product version remains 1.0.0 and Cargo.lock remains byte-identical.
No Git, editor, provider, prompt, session-start, or RRFlow runtime hook is installed.
Local validation remains bypassable until eligible server-side protection is separately proven; POAM-027 remains open.

implementation_changes.action: Create a dependency-free fail-closed validator for the active package, Git ancestry, full-file review, and committed/staged/unstaged/untracked path set.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Any malformed field, Git ambiguity, stale baseline, incomplete review, mixed plan/code commit, unplanned path, or plan drift exits nonzero with a precise diagnostic.

implementation_changes.action: Create isolated temporary-Git-repository tests for the positive path and each required denial without modifying the RRFlow checkout.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: A missing denial case or unexpected acceptance fails the test process.

implementation_changes.action: Fetch complete history in the verify job and execute the change-plan validator before build/test work.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: A rejected or unresolvable package stops candidate CI before compilation.

implementation_changes.action: Require full-history checkout and the exact change-plan command in the reusable candidate workflow.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Workflow drift fails the deterministic workflow policy.

implementation_changes.action: Require the provider-neutral instruction warp, execution-map owner section, and active plan record without duplicating the plan schema.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Removal or drift of the planning authority linkage fails documentation policy.

implementation_changes.action: Classify the active change record under J-01/J-02 repository engineering and register its two absent checker paths without making generated JSONL an authorization source.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: A missing, conflicting, or stale active-package inventory classification fails deterministic inventory generation or check mode.

implementation_changes.action: Document the exact plan-only commit, local presubmit, candidate-CI, bypass limitation, and later server-protection boundary.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Documentation cannot claim non-bypassable enforcement while POAM-027 remains open.

evidence_changes.action: Record the complete POAM-027a implementation journal before its code commit.
Regenerate the deterministic inventory after the new checker and test exist; never hand edit it.

research.reason: The package defines a repository integrity and review-control boundary whose bypass and Git-history behavior must be explicit.

sources.title: Git Hooks
sources.retained_behavior: Client hooks are not cloned and cannot establish portable repository policy.
sources.rejected_assumption: A local pre-commit or provider session hook can guarantee another checkout or server accepts only planned work.

sources.title: Google Engineering Practices: Small CLs
sources.retained_behavior: One self-contained change and its tests are reviewable as a unit.
sources.rejected_assumption: A broad roadmap is sufficient authorization for an unbounded implementation diff.

sources.title: GitHub ruleset rules
sources.retained_behavior: Server-side required checks and pull-request restrictions are the later non-bypassable enforcement layer.
sources.rejected_assumption: A checked-in script alone denies a repository administrator or direct filesystem mutation.

resource_evidence.reason: The validator uses bounded repository metadata and file hashing; tests exercise malformed and unplanned inputs without engine allocation claims.

debugging_evidence.reason: Mutation tests must prove each denial emits a stable, path-specific diagnostic.

first_failure_oracle: A temporary repository with a code change committed in the same commit as its plan must be rejected.
A temporary repository with one undeclared untracked implementation file must be rejected.
A plan whose reviewed line interval or SHA-256 does not cover the complete baseline file must be rejected.
edit_sequence: Add the validator and its isolated mutation-test harness.
Run the mutation tests before touching workflow integration and fix only validator defects they expose.
Add the validator command and full-history checkout to candidate CI.
Make workflow and documentation policy reject removal of the binding.
Update CI operations documentation with exact scope and bypass limitations.
Write the execution-map evidence journal, regenerate the file plan, reread all changed files and the complete diff, then run the acceptance commands.
acceptance_commands: ruff check scripts/ci/check_change_plan.py scripts/ci/test_change_plan.py scripts/ci/check_workflow.py scripts/ci/check_documentation.py
ruff format --check scripts/ci/check_change_plan.py scripts/ci/test_change_plan.py scripts/ci/check_workflow.py scripts/ci/check_documentation.py
stop_conditions: The plan cannot be proven to precede implementation in Git history.
A changed path, generated surface, owner record, dependency lock, or workflow is not declared.
A baseline file cannot be authenticated and covered from line 1 through its final line.
The validator would require a non-standard runtime dependency, network access, provider state, or local hook.
A test would mutate the RRFlow checkout instead of an isolated temporary repository.
The package would claim an engine gate, alpha readiness, or non-bypassable server enforcement.
